convert_tf_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert a TensorFlow GPT-Neo checkpoint to a PyTorch model using the config file and output path
load_tf_weights_in_gpt_neo: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a PyTorch GPT-Neo model with name mapping and transpose handling
build_gpt_neo_config_from_json: build a GPTNeoConfig from a JSON config file with n_embd, n_layer, n_head, and attention_types fields
run_tf_to_pytorch_conversion_cli: run the CLI script to convert a mesh TensorFlow GPT-Neo checkpoint to PyTorch with required args
set_output_embeddings_from_weights: initialize the final linear output layer using the word embedding weights from the model
